facts.fact: Before walking into the lower market, Devan watched Neela's meeting with 'Valli' for about a quarter hour from the shade of the tamarind wall (not the fish racks), until Muthu's laugh drew eyes and covered his approach. He saw the girl weigh the same measure twice and saw Neela's back go taut. He counts 'the coast girl who weighed twice' in his chain of suspicion: council, match, widow.
The council's seal dies were cut by the palace engraver, who is older than the queen (Muthu's remark).
The marriage settlement recorded in the writ is cloth, brass and four hundred panam.
Devan says he has laughed once before Neela made him laugh, 'a long time before' her. Muthu's next sparring request falls four days after ch 8's morning.
